GOLF ADVISORY COMMITTEE AGENDA
  THURSDAY, MARCH 26, 2026
  2760 N. STUDEBAKER ROAD
  PRM ADMINISTRATION, LARGE CONFERENCE ROOM, 3:00 PM

Kevin Fitzgerald, Chair  Jim Demetriou, Member
Larry Conkings, Vice Chair  Robert Meliere, Member
Clifford Aichele, Member  Joyce Ricci, Member
Stevie Anderson, Member  Angie Young, Member
Donna Barrett, Member

  SPECIAL MEETING

  Golf Advisory Committee In-Person Meeting

  Members of the public have the option to email public comments
  to lilia.romero@longbeach.gov

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  26-54722  Recommendation to review, discuss, and, if appropriate, approve the transmittal of a letter
  drafted by the AB 1954 Ad Hoc Committee to the Director advising that the Mayor and City
  Council offer their support for Assembly Bill (AB) 1954: Protecting Access to Reservations
  Act.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Golf Advisory Committee on non-agenda items. Each speaker is limited
to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Lilia Romero, Clerk Typist, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours prior to the
meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
Americans with Disabilities Act, please contact Lilia Romero at 562.570.3104 or
Lilia.Romero@longbeach.gov

  FINISHED AGENDA & DRAFT MINUTES

CALL TO ORDER

At 3:02 PM, Chair Fitzgerald called the meeting to order.

ROLL CALL

  Commissioners Present: Aichele, Barrett, Demetriou, Ricci, Young, Conkings, Fitzgerald

  Commissioners Absent: Anderson, Meliere

Also present: Sherlyn Beatty, Partnerships Officer, Lori Craig, Administrative Analyst, Lilia Romero,
Clerk Typist III.

Member Anderson and Member Meliere are excused from the meeting.

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  26-54722  Recommendation to review, discuss, and, if appropriate, approve the transmittal of a letter
  drafted by the AB 1954 Ad Hoc Committee to the Director advising that the Mayor and City
  Council offer their support for Assembly Bill (AB) 1954: Protecting Access to Reservations
  Act.

  A motion was made by Member Aichele, seconded by Member Barrett, to
  approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  7  Aichele, Barrett, Demetriou, Ricci, Young, Conkings, Fitzgerald
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 2  Anderson, Meliere

  Lori Craig, Administrative Analyst, Parks, Recreation and Marine, spoke.

  Chair Fitzgerald spoke.

  Member Aichele spoke.
